# Card 208: card-text proposal (objection window 208-cardtext)

Category: card-text fix (D153 L1). Proposed by: product manager (ready), Claude seat, ctx-1 of card 208.
Source: the adopted slice, .mob/records/208/turn-slice-architect.md (window 208-slice; commit 6bd8db2 amended f1b9b9a), sections 1, 2 and 7. Probe reference: .mob/records/probes/2026-10-30.jsonl (17:13 UTC, as cited by the slice; Codex, Copilot, Grok and agy without usable quota).
Edit the GitHub issues, not the generated board files.

## 1. Card 208: new title, Done checks, Not in this card

New title (replaces "The loop runner drives Avowry cards under today's gates"):
A seat starts only on a fresh, pinned probe, and a Claude seat only while no other model has quota

Replace "One observable behaviour":
- **One observable behaviour:** Given a card with a declared task force, the facilitator starts a seat only on a probe under 60 minutes old taken with a pinned probe model, and starts a Claude seat only while no other model has quota, writing the reason into the card record.

Replace "Done checks" (numbered before any red, D157):
- **Done checks (at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. A seat starts only on a probe under 60 minutes old (F-040, MD-002). Before every seat turn (seat_turn and turn) the facilitator checks the age of the last probe; at 60 minutes or more it probes again first; if it cannot probe (the probe raises or its evidence cannot be written) the seat is refused with exit 2 and a named reason, before any backend call. The seat's MOB.md entry and events line cite the probe's taken_at. ZOMBIES: Z (the card-start probe is the only one: no second probe before seat 1), O (one seat on a fresh probe: no re-probe), M (several seats, the third past 60 minutes: one re-probe, before it), B (exactly 60 minutes is stale, 59 minutes 59 seconds is fresh), E (probing fails: refused, no backend call, never staffed on the stale probe), I (every seat's cited probe is under 60 minutes old at its start). N/A: S, covered by the existing probe tests
  2. A Claude seat starts only while the fresh probe shows no other model with quota, and the record says why (MD-002). A seat on Claude is refused (exit 2, naming role, context and the model with quota) when any non-Claude backend's probe succeeded, in an all-Claude roster as today and now in a mixed roster; each Claude seat's entry in .mob/records/NNN.json gets quota_reason, built from the probe it relied on (taken_at plus each non-Claude backend's evidence), never typed by a seat. ZOMBIES: Z (no Claude seat: no refusal, no quota_reason), O (one Claude seat, all four others down: starts, reason cites the probe), M (three Claude seats across a re-probe: each reason cites its own probe), B (exactly one other model with quota refuses; a backend disabled in backends.json counts as no quota), E (a non-Claude backend missing from the results is refused, never read as no quota; and a probe whose evidence fails to write is refused for a mixed roster as well as an all-Claude one, before any backend call, exit 2), I (the refusal text names the seat and the model; exit 2). N/A: S, covered by the existing claude-only tests
  3. The probe model is pinned (MD-002). Each enabled backend in core/backends.json names probe_model, a key of its own models; probe_backend uses it (not the first dict entry) and the probe result records the model; a missing or unknown pin refuses the card at start (exit 2, naming the backend). ZOMBIES: Z (an enabled backend without probe_model is refused by name), O (one backend pinned, the model in its result), M (all five pinned, each result carries its model), B (a pin that is not a key of models is refused; reordering models does not change the probe model), E (a disabled backend needs no pin), I (the shipped backends.json passes). N/A: S, covered by the existing probe tests

Replace "Not in this card" (add if absent):
- **Not in this card:** the loop runner starting a corrective card while a finding blocks (card 220: the exemption after the pick, issue read, fail closed); running a card in the repository its Repository line names (card 221); the loop reading its retro, re-rank and discovery commands from the repository and stopping when a step fails or is missing (card 222); the per-card retro with feedback from every role, each in its own context (card 223); the re-rank led by the product manager and decided by a Decider, applied only after a pass (card 224); card mode reading only role lines of the declared format as the task force (card 225); a seat whose own declared model is unavailable keeps today's behaviour; the record checker requiring quota_reason (card 210); phrase-lang's probe_drivers.py.

Related text of card 208 to align in the same window (all from slice section 7; no rule changes):
- Replace "Type" with: - **Type:** tooling (corrective; the architect split the parent card: this card keeps the seat probe gate, six cards take the rest)
- Replace "Actor" with: - **Actor:** the mob-defaults card-mode facilitator (facilitator.py; the loop runner is unchanged by this card)
- Replace "Enables" with: - **Enables:** card 210 (its record check reads the quota_reason field this card writes), cards 223 and 224 (the retro and re-rank seats they start inherit this gate), and 212 and 215 through those two
- Replace "Depends on" with: - **Depends on:** none (D147: this card starts while MD-002 is an open FAIL because its issue names it; D160 puts it before 210)
- Context: replace the "Dry run" gaps list and "Proposed split for the architect" bullet with one bullet: "- Split by the architect (window 208-slice): the five runner gaps became cards 220 to 225; this card keeps the fresh-probe-before-every-seat gap (F-040) and the MD-002 additions. Each slice records in mob-defaults with a reference to D145 and D136, red test first (D137), and cites F-008 or MD-002 so it is a corrective commit."
- The issue's first line stays "Corrective action for MD-002 and F-008"; the Task force section and the declaration fix line are unchanged by this window (they are set by window 208-taskforce).

## 2. Enables and Depends on: cards 210, 212 and 215 (slice section 7)

Card 210 (Enables points the wrong way round after D160 put 208 first; its check 3 reads the field 208 criterion 2 writes). Replace the Enables line:
- **Enables:** 211 and every later card whose record the checker reads (the record check refuses empty, missing or self-reported fields by name)

Replace the Depends on line:
- **Depends on:** 208 (writes the quota_reason field in the record that Done check 3 requires of a Claude seat; D160 runs 208 first). D147: this card still starts while MD-003 is an open FAIL because its issue names it.

Replace Done check 3 (names the field in the ZOMBIES, as the slice asks; only "a reason" and the E case change):
  3. Per-member checks and the retro: each task force member needs a domain, a why and a context, the generic boilerplate roster is refused, a Claude seat needs a quota_reason (the field card 208 writes from the fresh probe), and the retro needs flow_metrics and practice_metrics that are non-empty structures, not truthy values. ZOMBIES: Z (a member with no fields), O (one member missing its domain), M (several members, one without a why), B (an empty why string, the boilerplate roster identical to the template default), E (a Claude seat with no quota_reason, a retro with flow_metrics set to true, a member whose domain, why or context is whitespace-only or the string "true"), I (a full record passes). Note for the facilitator: the Enables replacement for 210 is my reading of "its Enables line points at 208 the wrong way round". The card-record check does not enable 208 any more; it follows 208, so the line names the cards after it. Replace it with a different downstream card if the facilitator prefers; the Depends on line carries the real ordering. Card 210's refinement seat confirms both lines when its own window opens.

- **Depends on:** 224 and 222 (224: the re-rank through the product manager and a Decider; 222: the loop wiring that runs the re-rank step and stops when it fails or is missing; this card hardens the re-rank step they wire in). Keep 212's check 3 (a no-change re-rank still writes a note) as the gate-side test: the runner accepts the note; 224 criterion 2 covers the writing side.

Card 215 (its retro command moved from 208 to 223 and 222). Replace the Depends on line:
- **Depends on:** 223 and 222 (223: the per-card retro from every role, each in its own context; 222: the loop wiring that runs the retro step and stops when it fails or is missing; this card adds record fields to the step they wire in).

Enables lines of 212 and 215 stay as they are (205 is done; the later ones are unchanged by the split and not named in section 7).

## 3. Why this is neither a one-way door nor a standing-rule change

- Two-way door: the changes are card text on the board (the issues are edited, the board files regenerated); nothing is published outside the board, deleted or migrated, and any line can be restored by editing the issue again. The split itself was adopted by window 208-slice and its commits and records stay as they are; this window only brings card 208, 210, 212 and 215 into line with it. The new cards 220 to 225 are filed separately and are not changed here.
- No standing-rule change: no agreement text, D-record, checker or gate changes in this window. The Done checks move from the parent's text to the slice's text without a rule change; the parent's Done checks still bind the sum through the slice's mapping table (parent check to card). Dependencies change only because the work moved. D136, D145 (one fixed condition per objection), D147 (corrective-card start), D157 (at most 3 Done checks, criteria numbered before red) and D160 (order) are applied as written. The rule changes the slice's work will make (the runner and facilitator gates) belong to the cards and their own windows, not to this text change.
- Card-text fix under D153 L1: it may be proposed in the same window as the declaration it relates to, and it needs no separate Decider unless an objection stays unsettled.

## 4. Window rule

- Every declared role is polled (F-054): all seven role seats answer (product manager ready ctx-1 is the proposer; architect ctx-2, QA engineer ctx-3, backend developer ctx-4, independent reviewer (audit lens) ctx-5, delivery lead ctx-6, product manager (signoff) ctx-7), each in its own fresh context. A declared role that is not polled makes the window invalid. For the three other cards' lines (210, 212, 215), the roles declared on those cards are not polled here; their own refinement seat confirms the line when that card opens, and the one-line changes carry no behaviour of their own.
- Each seat answers either "no objection" or ONE fixed condition per objection (D145). A condition that is simply adopted and re-polled stays in the window; an unsettled objection goes to a full Decider.
- Results go in .mob/records/decisions/208-cardtext.json (window, category "card-text fix", rule "D153 objection window; card-text changes in the same window (D153 L1)", proposal, replies by round, decision), after the D158 pre-window checklist is committed. The adopted lines are applied to the issues after the window closes; the board files are regenerated, not hand-edited.
